sn20.7:1.2: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave dasārahānaṃ ānako nāma mudiṅgo ahosi.
sn20.7:1.3: tassa dasārahā ānake phaḷite aññaṃ āṇiṃ odahiṃsu.
sn20.7:1.4: ahu kho so bhikkhave samayo yaṃ ānakassa mudiṅgassa porāṇaṃ pokkharaṃ phalakaṃ antaradhāyi
sn20.7:1.6: evameva kho bhikkhave bhavissanti bhikkhū anāgatamaddhānaṃ ye te suttantā tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīratthā lokuttarā suññatapaṭisaññuttā tesu bhaññamānesu na sussusissanti na aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhāpessanti na ca te dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññissanti.
sn20.7:2.1: ye pana te suttantā kavikatā kāveyyā cittakkharā cittabyañjanā bāhirakā sāvakabhāsitā tesu bhaññamānesu sussusissanti sotaṃ odahissanti aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhāpessanti te ca dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññissanti.
sn20.7:2.2: evameva tesaṃ bhikkhave suttantānaṃ tathāgatabhāsitānaṃ gambhīrānaṃ gambhīratthānaṃ lokuttarānaṃ suññatapaṭisaññuttānaṃ antara dhānaṃ bhavissati.
sn20.7:2.4: ye te suttantā tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīratthā lokuttarā suññata paṭisaññuttā tesu bhaññamānesu sussusissāma sotaṃ oda hissāma aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhāpessāma te ca dhamme ugga hetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññissāmāti
